hypothesis_summary.name: Q07 Earnings Stability Sector-Neutralized + SUE Quality Boost (Defense)
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: 매월 t: (1) Q07_Earnings_Stability raw factor load_month_factors() 경유 로드, (2) cross-sectional z-score per sector (Z_Sector: Q07 - sector_mean(Q07) / sector_sd(Q07)), (3) winsorize 1~99%, (4) SUE (Standardized Unexpected Earnings) z-score cross-section으로 earnings surprise quality boost, (5) composite = 0.7·z_sector_Q07 + 0.3·z_SUE, (6) Top 20 EW Long, t+1 execution. S1 pure signal, NO overlay.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: L-121 Q07 양쪽 위기 최강 + L-136 D25+Q07 combo 실패는 '정상 구간 기회비용' 문제. sector-neutral 접근으로 (a) sector concentration 제거 + (b) 정상 구간 negative carry 완화 기대. H_1682 5-hypothesis H3 'long-only 20 concentration sector bias' 직접 해소.
hypothesis_summary.core_reference: Part A3.19 Q07 Earnings Stability + Dichev-Tang 2009 'Earnings Volatility and Earnings Predictability' ROS + Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984 TAR 'Earnings Releases, Anomalies and the Behavior of Security Returns' (SUE foundation)

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Dichev, Ilia D. and Vicki Wei Tang, 2009, 'Earnings Volatility and Earnings Predictability', Review of Accounting Studies 14, 277-299.
secondary_references: Foster, George; Olsen, Chris; Shevlin, Terry, 1984, 'Earnings Releases, Anomalies, and the Behavior of Security Returns', The Accounting Review 59(4), 574-603. (SUE foundational)
Bernard, Victor L. and Jacob K. Thomas, 1989, 'Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift', JAR 27, 1-36. (PEAD earnings surprise)
Sloan, Richard G., 1996, 'Do Stock Prices Fully Reflect Information in Accruals and Cash Flows about Future Earnings?', TAR 71, 289-315. (accrual → earnings quality)
Daniel, Kent and Sheridan Titman, 2006, 'Market Reactions to Tangible and Intangible Information', JF 61, 1605-1643. (sector-relative returns)
Asness, Cliff; Frazzini, Andrea; Pedersen, Lasse, 2019, 'Quality Minus Junk', Review of Accounting Studies 24, 34-112. (QMJ framework earnings stability component)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Dichev-Tang 2009: earnings volatility low → earnings predictability high → 위기 구간 valuation 보호. Foster-Olsen-Shevlin 1984 + Bernard-Thomas 1989 PEAD: SUE positive → 미래 수익률 underreaction → 3~9M drift. Sector-neutral: Daniel-Titman 2006 industry decomposition + 한국 재벌 cluster 실증 (KRX 2020-2024 sector HHI 통계 필요).
academic_foundation.korean_specific: 한국 KOSPI 재벌 cluster (삼성 8~12%, 현대 5~7%, LG 4~6%, SK 4~5% 시총 비중). Sector HHI ~1800-2200 (KRX 공시). Q07 단순 top-20 선택 시 재벌 cluster 과다 편중 위험. Sector-neutralization으로 각 sector 내 top Q07 종목 선택 → 15 sector × 1~2 종목 = 20종목 balanced.
mechanism_distinctive_from_prior_failure: H_1682 Distress+Calmar: distress 방향 모호 + Calmar past-based decay — H_1693는 Q07 방향 명확 (stability higher_better) + SUE forward-looking earnings surprise
L-136 D25+Q07 combo: D25 low-beta + Q07 2축 concentration → 정상 구간 기회비용 — H_1693는 Q07 + SUE 단일 quality axis, D25 제외로 정상 carry 회복
L-121 Q07 standalone 위기 강력 but 정상 구간 정보: sector-neutralization으로 재벌 cluster 제거 + SUE boost로 평시 return 보강
